morgan: Heads-up: staging shows fncall schema_reject fallbacks lose kvcache metrics in the console. Is that a telemetry gap?

lina: Yepkvcache emits only on successful fncall path today. Fallbacks skip emits.

samir: We skipped them to avoid billing confusion, but PMs want visibility for rollouts.

olivia: Proposal: always emit kvcache.* with labels fallback=true and fallback_reason="schema_reject" and include sampled="1pct" for high traffic. Billing ETL drops fallback=true.

morgan: Console UX concern: don't want card explosion. Add a per-dashboard toggle "include fallbacks" that adds the fallback dim. Default stays the same.

lina: I'll add a saved view and note about sampling.

samir: We'll derive fallback_rate in metrics pipeline and add an alert: >5% for 10m with min 1k calls.

infra-bot: deploy queued: metrics/fallback-labels -> infra/staging (owner: olivia)

olivia: Action items: (1) runtime emit + feature flag (olivia), (2) billing filter update (samir), (3) console filter + saved view + docs (lina), (4) 1% canary -> 10% -> full (morgan). I'll post sample metric lines and flag name after deploy.

morgan: Thanks 44d run 48h canary and reconvene.
